name: family-memory-contrast-v1
purpose: Measure whether general answer-scope guidance omits an incidental repair in a broad family summary while retaining it when explicitly requested.
design: One development attempt each for family summary, projector repair, and dog questions using the same three synthetic conversation records and independent deterministic case-specific checks. No retry, adaptive selection, paid API, household data, external effects, or delivery.
limits: A small tuned development contrast set, not held-out evidence or a semantic guarantee. Checks are literal and limited. Source text visible in prompt does not prove model attention. In-process owner processor only; no daemon claim, restart, UI or delivery.
